items.summary: Financial recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and do not expand monetization or approve spend. Amazon reported $4.92 commission on 2026-09-21 from 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items; all $4.92 is aggregate and site-attributed income is $0. AI usage cost was $759.78 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-23 across 39 sites. Contribution margin, cost-to-learn, payback, and ROI are not calculable because direct infrastructure, labor, domain, and allocated AI costs are unavailable, revenue periods do not align, and experiments have 0 measured outcomes. Minimum measurement: daily site/content revenue and clicks, shipped commission, direct costs, AI/infrastructure allocation, experiment exposure, and attributable conversion. Continue only existing report-only or reversible work with no new financial claims.

Attribution quality is insufficient for site-level revenue claims. Amazon's 2026-09-21 aggregate row contains $4.92 commission and 629 clicks that cannot be assigned without inventing attribution, while mapped site tracking IDs show zero commission. Treat SEO impressions, clicks, sessions, and conversions as funnel signals rather than revenue. Require reconciliation by site, tracking ID, content identifier, ordered and shipped status, commission, and reporting date before claiming contribution margin or forecasted revenue.
